snippet.title: How to reverse engineer QuotaPath with Claude: what passed, what broke
snippet.description:
Claude built a QuotaPath alternative from one Markdown spec: all 24 acceptance checks passed in a real browser, along with 48 automated tests.
The test build also exposed 10 gaps in the spec, and every one is now fixed.

We gave Claude one Markdown spec for a small-team sales commission calculator and had it build the tool in four phases: reps, plans and deals; the payout math and statements; approval, locking, clawbacks and the payroll export; and what reps see, with their own statement and a what-if calculator. The gaps included sign-in that had to match people by an email they didn't have, an approved month that recalculated to $8,860 instead of $10,060 because a deal cancelled after approval was left out, and a what-if split that could mean either rep's share. What passed, what broke, what we didn't test, and when QuotaPath is still worth paying for.
